_source: BPHS Chapter 34, verses 34.19-44 — COMPLETE. All twelve Lagnas source-resolved: ARIES 34.19-22, TAURUS 34.23-24, GEMINI 34.25-26, CANCER 34.27-28, LEO 34.29-30, VIRGO 34.31-32, LIBRA 34.33-34, SCORPIO 34.35-36, SAGITTARIUS 34.37-38, CAPRICORN 34.39-40, AQUARIUS 34.41-42, PISCES 34.43-44. This file is a PURE verse oracle: it stores only what the verse or a declared commentary/translation judgment states, tagged with provenance. Where a verse names a killer or a yoga agent explicitly while leaving the functional nature unclassified, maraka_provenance and yoga_provenance record those splits. Ownership-yogakaraka (a general-rule derivation) lives in its own section and is never mixed into per-Lagna verse cells. Per BPHS 34.45-46 these lordship roles are the BASE doctrine; Nabhasa and other yogas are downstream and must never rewrite them.
_schema: lagna -> graha -> {nature, verse_yoga, maraka, provenance, maraka_provenance, yoga_provenance, verse, conditional_rules}; provenance values: explicit_verse / derived_general_rule / translation_judgment / review_required. maraka_provenance and yoga_provenance are null when not separately specified.

_ownership_yogakaraka_derived._note: Derived from the general kendra+trikoṇa rule (BPHS 34.2/34.13), NOT from any Lagna-specific verse. The classical six.
